exposure: Obstetric risk factors (history of cesarean section, history of dilation and curettage, labor trial)
outcome: Maternal complications (maternal death, postpartum hemorrhage, bladder injury, hysterectomy, blood transfusion)
cohort: Patients who experienced uterine rupture during pregnancy and delivery at Hunan Maternal and Child Health Hospital in China between January 2013 and December 2022.
finding: Remarkably worse maternal outcomes, including higher rates of blood transfusion and bladder injury, were observed in patients with second-trimester uterine rupture compared to those with late-pregnancy rupture.
mod_finding: A labor trial was undertaken in 20.9% of the uterine rupture cases.
gest_age: Second trimester and at or after 28 weeks gestation (at time of rupture/delivery)
